It sounds like something is on a rampage
at the top of the tower!

Giallo: It's finally time.
Our lord N will become the hero!{VAR BE01}

Giallo: The hero will open up the
way to a new world!{VAR BE01}
Which means you Trainers can all prepare
to lose your Pokémon!

Team Plasma: No one can interfere
with Unova's new dawn!{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: Sheesh...
Losing to a kid...{VAR BE01}
But Team Plasma is
more than one person!

Team Plasma: You may have stopped me,
but my teammate will stop you here!{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: So your Pokémon have
gotten used to being your weapons...

Team Plasma: Here I come!
Plasmaaaa!!{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: Our king will create
a new world.{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: Our king will create
a new world.

Team Plasma: Bring it on!
Can you take on four in a row?{VAR BE01}

Team Plasma: I don't understand...
Why do you keep trying so hard?
